name: purge-app
description: Free up your Mac. Safely. A free, open-source native Mac app that clears the cache and junk your Mac piles up on its own. Files go to the Trash by default, so you can put them back.

latest_release.name: Purge v1.15.0
latest_release.body:
## Release highlights

- **Russian and Turkish**: Purge now runs in Russian and Turkish. Storage sizes on the Overview and in the sidebar also follow your language's units and your region's decimal separator.
- **More leftovers found**: The App Uninstaller now finds an app's scripts, cookies and website data, its hidden files, and its caches, preferences and logs in the shared Library folder.
- **Xcode's Metal Toolchain**: Dev Tools lists Xcode's optional Metal Toolchain, about 900 MB, and removes it with Xcode's own tool. It is Check First and is deleted permanently.
- **uv cache**: Dev Tools now offers uv's package cache, which can grow to tens of GB. It is Check First.
- **Apple Intelligence errors in full**: When removing the Apple Intelligence models fails, a Details button shows everything macOS answered, ready to copy into a report.

## What's changed

* feat: remove Xcode's optional Metal Toolchain with xcodebuild (#132) by @jithin-sabu in #340
* feat: add Russian (ru) localization (#342) by @alexkirov288-hub in #341
* fix: show and log the full error when an Apple Intelligence removal fails (#343) by @jithin-sabu in #344
* fix: localize the storage unit and decimal separator by @alexkirov288-hub in #347
* fix: add the Russian text for the Apple Intelligence error details and storage units (#343) by @jithin-sabu in #348
* feat: offer the uv cache as Check First (#345) by @jithin-sabu in #349
* feat: add Turkish localization by @dermanonline in #350
* feat: find app leftovers in more Library folders (#352) by @jithin-sabu in #356
* test: pin that the Quick Look thumbnail cache is never offered (#353) by @jithin-sabu in #357
* docs: bring the README in line with the app (#358) by @jithin-sabu in #359
* fix: correct the Russian custom interval, admin prompt and delete sheet text by @jithin-sabu in #360
* docs: close the gaps left in the Chinese and Russian READMEs by @jithin-sabu in #361

## Thanks

* @alexkirov288-hub for the Russian translation in #341 and the localized storage units in #347
* @dermanonline for the Turkish translation in #350
* @RayBB for asking for the uv cache in #345
* @BertonYang1229 for reporting the Apple Intelligence removal failure in #343

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/jithin-sabu/purge-app/compare/v1.14.1...v1.15.0

See the assets below to download and install this version.
